long_biography.plain_text:
Quieter, more efficient compressors are central to Roberto Balma’s work at FNA. The Italian industrialist emphasises reducing noise at its source by redesigning components, alongside cutting energy consumption. His customer approach begins with assessing a factory’s compressed-air needs, then selecting suitable equipment. Training distributors to conduct those assessments forms part of the same service.

An alpine skier, Balma became president of Sci Club Sansicario in 2021. He set out a programme of improved equipment and broader training for young racers, with physical preparation and character development alongside skiing technique. His ambition for the club is to prepare athletes for challenges beyond competition.
